overview.description: The Franklin Responsibly Sourced Gold ETF (FGDL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the LBMA Gold Price index. The fund provides the price movement of gold spot price, less expenses and liabilities, using gold bars that meet London Bullion Market Associations responsible gold guidance. FGDL was launched on Jun 30, 2022 and is issued by Franklin Templeton.

data.title: The Best Gold ETFs With Low Costs
data.text: These gold ETFs provide investors with numerous ways to play the metal, from direct exposure to stock-related angles, on the cheap.
